title: Rclone Uploads Large Files to Root Instead of Specified Folder Despite Folder ID Configuration DRIME Cloud
body: Hi, I connected to Drime in the rclone with a specific folder ID. But if I upload small files like 5/10mb, it works. But when I try to upload bigger files like 1G, it fails the verification, and upon checking, I can see the file is uploaded in the root directory. Whereas I specified the folder ID in rclone config, so it shouldn't upload the files to the root instead of the specified folder. What am I missing? Can anyone help fix the issue, please? Thank You! Even after this https://github.com/rclone/rclone/pull/9391 update I downloaded rclone again and reconfigured. But it's still the same. instead of getting uploaded here in Rclone Folder- The file got uploaded here- In the root folder, which is the wrong location, as the folder ID I used in rclone config was the 'Rclone' folder's ID. Configured several times, every time facing the same issue.

comments.author: participant1
comments.body:
I think this is to do with the multipart upload API which takes a path for the destination file (unlike the rest of the api).

https://github.com/rclone/rclone/blob/9f89102a574c841dbb00f2e8acdaa77c1b3b8a60/backend/drime/drime.go#L1132

We are giving it a path relative to your folder id but the API is treating it as relative to the root which explains the symptoms.

Rclone doesn't know the path from the root to your folder id at the moment so we need to figure that out first... This isn't completely straight forward and turned out to be the hardest part of the fix!

Please give this a go

[v1.75.0-beta.9689.15255cb1c.fix-9392-drime-upload](https://<redacted-host>/branch/fix-9392-drime-upload/v1.75.0-beta.9689.15255cb1c.fix-9392-drime-upload/) on branch [fix-9392-drime-upload](https://github.com/rclone/rclone/tree/fix-9392-drime-upload) (uploaded in 15-30 mins)

The rclone branch here https://github.com/participant3/rclone/tree/fix-drime-0-dir-issue seems to work for me.
Diff: https://github.com/rclone/rclone/compare/master...participant3:rclone:fix-drime-0-dir-issue

It was written by AI with the following description of the fix

> The root cause was the relativePath value — I was sending the full drive-root absolute path ("dummydata/0/500") which caused the API to place files in a different folder than the parentId specified. The fix is to use just the filename ("500") as relativePath, matching the single-part upload convention.

Here's a summary of all the fixes needed:

|#	|Issue	|Fix|
| --- | --------- | --- |
|1	|listAll used folderId query param (ignored by API)	|Changed to parentIds|
|2	|MultiPartCreateRequest.ParentID and MultiPartEntriesRequest.ParentID had json:"parent_id" (snake_case, ignored by API)	|Changed to json:"parentId"
|3	|MultiPartCompleteRequest had no metadata fields (file landed at root without parentId)	|Added all metadata fields matching pydrime
|4	|relativePath was the full drive-root absolute path ("dummydata/0/500") causing file to land in wrong folder	|Changed to just the filename (leaf), matching single-part upload convention
